resources.string: Ask about the documents on your PC from your phone.
Go to Settings > Phone, turn it on and choose \"Show QR code\".
Scan the code with this phone. Phone and PC must be on the same Wi-Fi.
How much do I have to pay, and by when?
Your documents and the AI model stay on your PC. The phone connects over your home network, encrypted, and only shows the answers.
Point the camera at the QR code on your PC\'s screen.
StarkLLM uses the camera only when you tap: to read your PC\'s QR code or to photograph a letter for your PC. Nothing is recorded in the background.
This is not a StarkLLM pairing code.
StarkLLM will connect to this PC on your home network (%1$s). Only continue if the code is shown on your own PC.
The PC cannot be reached. Is it on, is StarkLLM running, and are the phone and the PC on the same Wi-Fi?

Another device answered at the PC\'s address, not the paired PC (its certificate differs). Nothing was sent, and the pairing is kept. If StarkLLM was reinstalled on the PC, pair again with a new QR code.
This code has expired or was already used. Show a new QR code on the PC.
The PC did not accept the code. Show a new QR code on the PC.
Ten phones are paired with this PC already. Remove one on the PC first (Settings > Phone).
This phone is no longer paired with the PC. Pair it again.
StarkLLM on the PC is fully offline, so it does not accept the phone right now.
StarkLLM on the PC could not do this. Try again in a moment.
StarkLLM on the PC has no signed-in account for this phone. Open StarkLLM on the PC and sign in. If the PC has several accounts, pair this phone again while your account is signed in on the PC.
No workspaces yet. Create one in StarkLLM on your PC.
No chats in this workspace yet.
Delete \"%1$s\" on the PC as well? This cannot be undone.
Ask anything about the documents in this workspace.
StarkLLM did not find these quoted words in the documents. Check them before you rely on them:
To use StarkLLM again you need a new QR code from the PC. Also remove this phone on the PC under Settings > Phone.
The PC does not allow this for this phone. You can change it on the PC under Settings > Phone.
Pair this phone with your PC first.
What would you like to know about your documents?
The PC is writing down what you said…
Goes into the workspace \"%1$s\" on your PC; the PC reads it, also the text in photos.
Also search the knowledge base folders
Sent to \"%1$s\". The PC is reading it now.
Nothing was understood. Hold the button while you speak.
The backup on the PC is done and tested.
The backup on the PC did not work. Look at Settings > Backup on the PC.
StarkLLM on the PC is now fully offline. The phone can reach it again when you switch it back on the PC.
StarkLLM on the PC reads these dates from your letters by fixed rules; no AI model guesses them. Check the letter before you rely on a date.
On: documents and chats are encrypted on the PC
Ask, send and manage this PC
StarkLLM on the PC stops every connection, also to this phone. To use the phone again, switch it back on the PC (Settings > Privacy & network).
To start a backup or switch StarkLLM offline from this phone, allow \"manage\" for it on the PC under Settings > Phone.
Ask for the fingerprint, face or PIN when the app opens
Set up a screen lock on the phone first
When the phone is at home, it checks the PC every few hours. No cloud service.
Add the tile \"Ask StarkLLM\" to Quick Settings, and the widget \"StarkLLM deadlines\" to the home screen. Share PDFs and photos from other apps to StarkLLM.
Free and open source. Your documents stay on your PC.
The next deadlines from your letters
Another answer is still coming in. Ask again in a moment.
Hi, I\'m Lucy! Here is everything the app can do. Tap a topic.
StarkLLM runs on your PC. This app is its window on your phone: you ask, your PC reads and answers. No cloud.
Ask about your letters and books, photograph a new letter for your PC, dictate a question, and get reminded of deadlines.
On your PC: StarkLLM, Settings > Phone, \"Show QR code\". Scan it with this phone, and they know each other.

• On the PC: StarkLLM > Settings > Phone > Turn on > Show QR code.
• In the app: Scan QR code, then Pair.
• Phone and PC must be on the same Wi-Fi. Windows may ask once: allow private networks only.
• More PCs: menu > your PC > Pair another PC.

• Choose the workspace with the folder chip above the question field, then ask.
• Under the answer: the documents it used. An amber note warns about quoted words that are not in your documents.
• "+" chooses the AI model and the knowledge base.
• You may leave the chat or the app: the answer keeps coming in.

• "+" > Camera: photograph a letter; the PC reads the text (OCR).
• "+" > Photos or Files: PDF, EPUB, Word, PowerPoint, text, images.
• From other apps: Share > StarkLLM, then choose the workspace.
• The PC indexes it; after a moment you can ask about it.

• Hold the microphone button while you speak, then let go.\n• The recording goes to your PC; its speech model writes the text into the question field. No online service.\n• The first time, the PC downloads its speech model once.

• The PC reads due dates and amounts from your letters by fixed rules (no AI guessing).
• "Done" marks a deadline as paid or handled, on the PC too.
• Settings > Deadline reminders: while the phone is at home, it checks the PC every few hours.
• Widget "StarkLLM deadlines": long-press the home screen > Widgets.
PCs and what a phone may do

• On the PC, Settings > Phone sets for each phone: ask only, ask and send documents, or also manage the PC.\n• \"This PC\" shows the model, backup and protection, and at \"manage\" offers Back up now and Switch fully offline, each after your fingerprint.\n• Several PCs: switch in the menu.

• Documents and the AI model never leave your PC; the phone only shows answers.
• The connection is encrypted, and the phone trusts only the PC whose QR code it scanned.
• The phone's key is locked in the Android Keystore; the app has no cloud backup, no ads and no tracking.
• Settings > App lock asks for your fingerprint when the app opens.

• "PC cannot be reached": is the PC on, is StarkLLM running, is the phone on the same Wi-Fi, and did Windows allow private networks?
• "Not the paired PC": StarkLLM was reinstalled or its certificate is new; pair again with a new QR code.
• "The PC does not allow this": change the level on the PC under Settings > Phone.
• "Fully offline": switch it back on the PC under Settings > Privacy & network.
The camera cannot be used right now (this phone has none, or another app is using it). Close other camera apps and try again.
Dictation needs the microphone. Android did not allow it; you can allow it in the app\'s settings.
Reminders need permission to show notifications. You can allow it in the app\'s settings.
StarkLLM cannot send this file. Share it from an app that offers it as a document.
This phone may only reach the PC in your home network. To use it away from home, allow it on the PC under Settings > Phone.
Pair the phone in your home network, in the same Wi-Fi as the PC.
